integrity: The proof is exact. In the upper-base stratum, the Smith equation for pq=(a,c)_B reduces to pq-p-q=a(B-1). The remaining digit bound is a quadratic inequality whose two roots convert the admissible bases into a divisor cutoff. Finite enumeration is used only to corroborate the symbolic classification and the small-prime corollaries.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to bases B with q<B<=pq, where both prime factors of the semiprime pq are one-digit and the product is two-digit. Smaller bases may contribute additional Smith bases. The historically closest Vella--Vella 2001 article on Smith and Dunckley numbers was identified but its full text was not accessible through the inspected routes, so possible prior coverage there remains the main originality risk.
title: Exact upper-base spectrum of Smith semiprimes
